strings.zh: 洞窟中的道路{NEWLINE}分成两条的时候。{CLEAR}其中一条是正确的,{CLEAR}还有一条可能是死路。{SCROLL}但是啊,人如果不是{NEWLINE}两条道路都试过的话,{CLEAR}是不会甘心的吧？{SCROLL}向上的梯子,{NEWLINE}还是向下的梯子……{SCROLL}你选择哪一个呢？
strings.en: When a path in a cave splits in{NEWLINE}two, one way is the right one, and{CLEAR}the other might be a dead end.{SCROLL}But people are never satisfied until{NEWLINE}they’ve tried both paths, are they?{SCROLL}The ladder going up, or{NEWLINE}the ladder going down...{SCROLL}Which one will you choose?

strings.zh: 岩石系技能总给人一种{NEWLINE}坚硬强大的感觉,{CLEAR}但其实也有一些岩石系技能{CLEAR}充满了特殊的技巧。{SCROLL}你如果能给我一个月亮球,{NEWLINE}我就可以把非常特殊的岩石系技能{CLEAR}力量宝石教给你的精灵。{SCROLL}怎么样,要学吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Rock-type moves always seem hard and{NEWLINE}powerful, but some Rock-type moves{CLEAR}are actually full of special technique.{SCROLL}If you give me a Moon Ball, I can{NEWLINE}teach your Pokémon a very special{CLEAR}Rock-type move: Power Gem.{SCROLL}Well? Want to learn it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 岛周围的漩涡是{NEWLINE}海神大人创造出的。{CLEAR}有听说过这样的传说。{SCROLL}如果没有记住特别的技能,{NEWLINE}就不能往前走了。
strings.en: I’ve heard a legend that the whirlpools{NEWLINE}around the islands were created by the{CLEAR}sea god.{SCROLL}You can’t go any farther without a{NEWLINE}special move.
